# Sunset clouds: long flat low-poly slabs in pink, coral and amber, unlit, facing the camera.
new
material new CloudA --base-color 1.0000 0.4784 0.4902 --emission 1.0000 0.4784 0.4902 --no-slot
material new CloudB --base-color 0.9608 0.6314 0.3647 --emission 0.9608 0.6314 0.3647 --no-slot
material new CloudC --base-color 0.8392 0.1020 0.5333 --emission 0.8392 0.1020 0.5333 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Cloud0 --vertices 6 --radius 1 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0
scale 2.0 0.25 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set location -5.5 0 5.2
material assign CloudA
add mesh cylinder --name Cloud1 --vertices 6 --radius 1 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.3 0.2 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set location -3.2 0 4.7
material assign CloudC
add mesh cylinder --name Cloud2 --vertices 6 --radius 1 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0
scale 2.3 0.275 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 4.8 0 6.1
material assign CloudB
add mesh cylinder --name Cloud3 --vertices 6 --radius 1 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.2 0.2 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 6.6 0 5.5
material assign CloudA
add mesh cylinder --name Cloud4 --vertices 6 --radius 1 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.5 0.225 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set location 0.8 0 6.8
material assign CloudC
add mesh cylinder --name Cloud5 --vertices 6 --radius 1 --depth 0.1 --location 0 0 0
scale 1.1 0.16 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set location -1.0 0 3.9
material assign CloudB
select all
shade flat
export clouds.glb
